question:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which gives the meaning of the given idiom or phrase.
A stitch in time saves nine
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "Timely action prevents more work".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"A stitch in time saves nine"** means that taking quick and timely action can prevent more significant problems or additional work later. (समय पर किया गया कार्य बाद में अधिक काम को रोकता है।)

 
 
• **Example:** Fixing the small leak in the pipe now is better than waiting for it to burst and cause bigger damage.
 
 

 
• **"Timely action prevents more work"** is the direct meaning of the idiom. It emphasizes the importance of resolving issues promptly to avoid escalation. (समय पर कार्य करना अधिक काम को रोकता है।)

 
 
• **Example:** Repairing the roof before the rainy season saved us from major repairs and expenses.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Tailoring is a valuable skill** (सिलाई एक मूल्यवान कौशल है): This option is unrelated to the idiom but refers to the importance of tailoring as a craft.

 
 
• **Example:** Tailoring allows people to create custom-fit clothing that suits their body and style.
 
 

 
• **Option 2: Drunk or intoxicated** (नशे में): This option has no connection to the idiom. It refers to the state of being under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

 
 
• **Example:** He was clearly intoxicated at the party and couldn't drive home safely.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Saving money for the future** (भविष्य के लिए पैसे बचाना): While this might involve planning ahead, it does not capture the essence of the idiom.

 
 
• **Example:** She started saving money early to ensure financial security in her retirement.
